verdict.rationale: Bolt's architecture runs projects in an isolated browser-based WebContainer with full control over filesystem/server/terminal (bolt-gh-2, bolt-gh-1/3/4), which implies a sandboxed dev environment separate from any deployed production instance, and code-view edits are described as free/token-free tinkering (bolt-docs-3). However, there is no explicit documentation of a staging-vs-production split or protections against touching live/production data, and one community report describes an incident where AI changes and undisclosed deployments broke a live production app's payment functionality (bolt-comm-7), suggesting the isolation is not guaranteed once a project is connected to real services like Supabase/Stripe. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment feature separate from production, documented data-isolation guarantees when using integrations like Supabase, and independent confirmation that production data can't be affected.
